title: Study to assess the safety, tolerability, and effects of vortosiran in two groups: participants who previously had a blood clot and completed initial blood-thinner treatment, and participants with cancer who are at high risk of blood clots
official: Randomized, Double blind, Phase II Trial of Vortosiran to Evaluate Safety, Tolerability, and Pharmacodynamic Efficacy in Participants with Prior Venous Thromboembolism After Completion of Initial Anticoagulant Therapy (Cohort A) and in Cancer Patients at High Risk of Venous Thromboembolism (Cohort B)
summary: Main objective: To evaluate the pharmacodynamic (PD) effect of vortosiran at two dose levels on Factor XI (FXI) activity at Week 8
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. 1. Cohort A and B: Adult male and female participants (≥18 years)
2. 10. Cohort B: Initiation of a new course of systemic chemotherapy with a minimum intended duration of ≥3 months
3. 11. Cohort B: Intermediate–high risk of VTE, defined as a Khorana score ≥2 at screening.
4. 2.Cohort A and B: Women of childbearing potential must agree to use highly effective contraception
5. 3.Cohort A: Objectively confirmed symptomatic index DVT of the lower limbs at the popliteal vein or more proximal, and/or symptomatic PE, documented by objective imaging modalities
6. 4. Cohort A: Completed 3 to 12 months of standard therapeutic anticoagulant therapy for the index VTE episode at least 2 weeks before randomization
7. 5. Cohort A: No recurrent VTE during the initial 3 to 12 months anticoagulant therapy treatment period.
8. 6. Cohort A: Clinical equipoise for extended anticoagulation, and discontinuation of anticoagulation is consistent with local standard of care for this patient profile. Specifically, clinical equipoise for extended anticoagulation.
9. 7. Cohort A: Hemodynamically stable at screening and, in the investigator’s judgment, suitable for outpatient follow-up.
10. 8. Cohort B: Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group performance status 0-2 during screening
11. 9. Cohort B: Newly diagnosed cancer site or progression of malignant disease
Exclusion criteria:
1. 1. Cohort A and B: Pregnancy or breastfeeding
2. 10. Cohort A:  Active clinically significant bleeding or conditions associated with unacceptably high bleeding risk.
3. 11. Cohort A: Severe uncontrolled hypertension.
4. 12. Cohort B: High bleeding risk.
5. 13. Cohort B: Hepatic disease with coagulopathy.
6. 14. Cohort B: Cancer types not eligible as the sole diagnosis: Basal cell or squamous cell carcinoma of the skin only Acute leukemia Myeloproliferative neoplasm
7. 15. Cohort B: Planned stem cell transplantation
8. 2. Cohort A and B: Evidence of active hepatitis B virus (HBV), hepatitis C virus (HCV), or human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) infection at screening
9. 3. Cohort A and B: Planned surgery that may change VTE/bleeding risk during the trial period and no recent surgery (≤2 weeks prior screening).
10. 4. Cohort A and B: Any serious medical, psychiatric, or social condition that, in the investigator’s opinion, would interfere with trial participation, compliance, or interpretation of trial results.
11. 5. Cohort A and B: The estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) <30 mL/min
12. 6. Cohort A: Clear indication for indefinite/extended anticoagulation for any reason
13. 7. Cohort A: Any absolute contraindication to continuation of anticoagulation (eg, recent life-threatening bleeding, intracranial hemorrhage, major spinal/eye surgery with unresolved risk).
14. 8. Cohort A: Concomitant antithrombotic therapy that would confound assessment or unacceptably increase bleeding risk.
15. 9. Cohort A: Relevant baseline laboratory abnormalities at screening: Hemoglobin <10 g/dL Platelet count <100,000/109 cells/L Alanine Aminotransferase (ALT) or AST (Aspartate Aminotransferase) > 1.5 × Upper Limit of Normal (ULN) Total bilirubin >1.5 × ULN
